name: io.github.opensmm-protocol/mcp-server
description: OpenSMM Protocol — open MCP server and REST gateway for ordering social media growth services (SMM) via AI agents. Provider-neutral catalog and quotes (the bundled catalog is a demo mock: ordering needs a connected provider), idempotent orders, pseudonymous provider showcase with measured quality, x402/USDC direct settlement tested on Base Sepolia (testnet).
